description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for Spring Boot applications integrated with Vert.x. It provides common startup, shutdown, and configuration management functionalities, including deployment of verticles, health check server setup, and lifecycle handling.

classes.name: AbstractBaseApplication
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational lifecycle and configuration management for Spring Boot applications that use Vert.x, including deployment, health checks, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: setVertx
methods.description: Sets the Vert.x instance, required for deployment.

methods.name: setHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Sets the health check server for the application.

methods.name: preFlightCheck
methods.description: Allows subclasses to perform checks before startup; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method executing the startup sequence: deployment, registration, health checks, and timeout handling.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Deploys verticles; can be overridden for custom deployment logic.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Initiates application shutdown with default timeout.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Performs controlled shutdown with specified wait time and handler.

methods.name: postRegisterServiceVerticles
methods.description: Hook for post-deployment actions; can be overridden.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook for actions before shutdown; can be overridden.
